Title: Account Management
Implementation Statement: lab03-target has two interactive accounts: gsarfo (system administrator) and gvmscan (dedicated scan account used only by GVM). Each account has a single documented purpose and is explicitly listed in the SSH AllowUsers directive. Inactive accounts are handled through periodic account review in place of password-expiry disablement (see password-aging risk acceptance memo). Gap: no documented emergency/break-glass account or recovery procedure; account review is not yet recorded on a schedule.

Title: Access Enforcement
Implementation Statement: Boot-time access is enforced by a GRUB superuser (grubadmin) with a PBKDF2-hashed password: normal boot is unrestricted, but editing boot entries requires the password and recovery entries are disabled. AppArmor is enabled at boot. sudo access is restricted and secure_path excludes /snap/bin. Remaining AppArmor profiles not in enforce/complain mode are tracked separately.

Title: Least Privilege
Implementation Statement: Root login over SSH is disabled; administrative actions require sudo by the named administrator. The gvmscan account exists solely for authenticated scanning and is not used interactively. sudo secure_path was restricted (/etc/sudoers.d/10-secure-path) and validated with visudo -c. A stricter default umask prevents root-created files from being readable by other users.

Title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
Implementation Statement: pam_faillock locks an account after 4 consecutive failed authentication attempts, including mistyped sudo passwords. SSH limits authentication attempts per connection and applies login delays. Effectiveness was demonstrated during the lab when the administrator account locked and required faillock --reset, and when the GVM default-credential brute-force check timed out against the hardened service.

Title: System Use Notification
Implementation Statement: A system use banner is displayed before SSH authentication and on local login, applied by the CIS Level 1 remediation script and verified during second-session SSH testing.

Title: Session Termination
Implementation Statement: Idle SSH sessions are terminated after approximately 15 minutes of inactivity through ClientAliveInterval/ClientAliveCountMax settings in the hardened sshd configuration.

Title: Remote Access
Implementation Statement: Remote administration is permitted only over SSH. The host firewall (ufw) allows SSH only from the LabNet subnet 10.0.5.0/24. AllowUsers restricts SSH to gsarfo and gvmscan; root login is disabled; empty passwords are rejected; and SSH is restricted to hardened ciphers, MACs, and key exchange algorithms. The host ED25519 key fingerprint was verified on first connection.

Title: Event Logging
Implementation Statement: System logging is provided by systemd-journald and rsyslog (rsyslog verified active 2026-10-19), configured to CIS Level 1 Server requirements, including sudo logging; log file permissions under /var/log were corrected and verified. The Linux audit daemon (auditd) is not active; auditd rules fall under CIS Level 2 and were outside the approved Level 1 baseline. Logs are retained locally only. Gap: no auditd event auditing, centralized log collection, or defined review process; planned for Lab 05 (Continuous Monitoring & Log Analysis).

Title: Audit Record Generation
Implementation Statement: Audit records for authentication, sudo use, and system services are generated by journald and rsyslog under the CIS Level 1 baseline. Gap: auditd is not active, so kernel-level event auditing (file access, privileged command execution) is not generated, and records are not forwarded to a central collector or correlated; addressed in Lab 05.

Title: Plan of Action and Milestones
Implementation Statement: A POA&M is maintained across Labs 01-04 with sequential IDs, weakness, mapped control, severity, planned action, scheduled completion, and status. Items are closed only with evidence (e.g., POA&M-002 closed 2026-10-16 by authenticated scan; POA&M-003 closed via Lab 02).

Title: Continuous Monitoring
Implementation Statement: The Configuration Baseline Standard requires scanning against the tailored profile before entering service, after significant change, and at least monthly. A find-fix-verify cycle was demonstrated with a GVM rescan and delta report. Gap: monitoring is manual and point-in-time; no automated scheduled scans or log monitoring yet.

Title: Baseline Configuration
Implementation Statement: The approved baseline is CIS Ubuntu Linux 24.04 LTS Benchmark v1.0.0 Level 1 Server, delivered through SCAP Security Guide 0.1.82 and tailored in lab03-tailoring.xml (profile lab03_cis_l1_server_tailored). Snapshots preserve the pre-hardening and pre-remediation states.

Title: Configuration Settings
Implementation Statement: Settings were applied via a reviewed 398-fix remediation script plus manual fixes, raising the OpenSCAP score from 68.83 to 97.58 (tailored). All 112 baseline failures are dispositioned: 102 remediated, 7 not applicable, 3 risk-accepted. Each deviation is recorded in the deviation register with justification.

Title: Least Functionality
Implementation Statement: Unused kernel modules and filesystems are disabled, cleartext client packages are removed, and /tmp is mounted noexec, nosuid, nodev. Postfix (installed as an AIDE dependency) listens on loopback only. Gap: some AppArmor profiles are not in enforce or complain mode.

Title: System Component Inventory
Implementation Statement: System components are inventoried from Lab 02 network enumeration and recorded in CISO Assistant as assets AST-001 (lab03-target, primary) and AST-002 (Kali-GVM-Scanner, supporting), with hardware, OS version, kernel, and network attributes documented in the SSP.
Evidence: Lab 02 CM-8 inventory; CISO Assistant asset list

Title: System Recovery and Reconstitution
Implementation Statement: Recovery objectives are defined (RTO 24h, RPO 24h, MTD 72h), and VM snapshots exist. Gap: no documented, tested break-glass and recovery procedure. Recovery during Lab 03 required rescue media after the only administrator was locked out.
Evidence: CISO Assistant asset DR objectives; Lab 03 change log

Title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
Implementation Statement: Each user authenticates with a unique named account; shared and root SSH logins are not permitted. Gap: SSH uses password authentication without multi-factor authentication for the privileged account, which the Low baseline requires under IA-2(1).

Title: Authenticator Management
Implementation Statement: pam_pwquality enforces a minimum length of 14 with quality checks, and pam_pwhistory prevents reuse. Periodic forced expiration is not enforced, per NIST SP 800-63B and a documented risk acceptance memo (reviewed 2027-10-07); passwords are changed upon evidence of compromise. Note: The GVM application password policy on the supporting asset is tracked separately.

Title: Risk Assessment
Implementation Statement: Risks are assessed per finding, with likelihood and impact in two risk acceptance memos (password aging; inherited CPU mitigations). Gap: no system-level risk assessment register; to be built in CISO Assistant as part of this lab.

Title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
Implementation Statement: Vulnerability scanning uses GVM (Greenbone Community Feed) from a dedicated Kali scanner. An authenticated scan over SSH as gvmscan on 2026-10-16 found 0 Critical, 0 High, 2 Medium, 1 Low; the Low finding was remediated and confirmed gone by a rescan and delta report. Authentication success is evidenced by the SSH Login Successful result (RA-5(5))

Title: Boundary Protection
Implementation Statement: lab03-target sits on the isolated VirtualBox NAT Network LabNet (10.0.5.0/24). UFW is active with default-deny inbound, and SSH is permitted only from 10.0.5.0/24; hardened kernel network parameters are applied, and TCP timestamps are disabled. Gaps: outbound traffic is allowed by default, and one listening port (likely SSH on IPv6) lacks a matching rule.

Title: Flaw Remediation
Implementation Statement: The OS was fully patched before the re-scan (35 pending security updates reduced to 0) and verified by a re-scan. Automatic security updates are enabled through unattended-upgrades (service enabled; APT::Periodic Update-Package-Lists and Unattended-Upgrade set to 1, verified 2026-10-19). Two Medium CPU-mitigation findings are inherited from the host firmware and VirtualBox and are risk-accepted with compensating controls (reviewed 2027-04-16).
Evidence: lab03-pending-updates.txt; lab03-patching.log; risk acceptance memo (CPU mitigations)

Title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
Implementation Statement: AIDE file integrity monitoring is installed and initialized with the CIS Level 1 baseline database.
